description: This is a Java interface for the User repository in a Spring Boot application, extending JpaRepository to provide database operations for User entities, including methods to find users by username and email, and to check existence by username or email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entity, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their username.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their email address.

methods.name: existsByUsername
methods.description: Checks if a User with the given username exists.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a User with the given email exists.
